main.name: Darshan Patel
main.description: Backend and messaging infrastructure engineer specializing in Java, Spring Boot, Apache Kafka, and CI/CD for distributed trading systems
main.bio: My name is Darshan Patel, I'm a Java Software Engineer on the Core Infrastructure team at Clearpool Group (BMO Capital Markets), where I manage Apache Kafka messaging, Java/Spring Boot deployments, and the CI/CD tooling that keeps seven engineering teams shipping to production.
main.contactmessage: Get in touch with me to receive further details, or anything else.

resume.summary: Java Software Engineer with 5+ years building and operating backend and event-driven messaging infrastructure for capital markets trading platforms. Core Infrastructure team member managing 550+ Apache Kafka topics and Java/Spring Boot deployments in production, supporting 60+ live Dynamic Message Object (DMO) data contracts, and remediating 20,000+ Linux and Java dependency vulnerabilities in six months. Re-engineered a bash-based deployment pipeline into a database-driven, multi-threaded process, cutting deployment time 60% (30 minutes to 12). Supports 7 engineering teams across CI/CD, distributed systems, and release management.
resume.skillmessage: Core technical skills across backend engineering, event-driven messaging, and cloud infrastructure.

work.title: Software Development Engineer, Core Infrastructure
highlights: Manage 550+ Apache Kafka topics in production, supporting Java-based services and deployments across multiple products organization-wide.
Re-engineered the deployment pipeline from bash scripting into a database-driven, multi-threaded Java process, reducing deployment time from 30 to 12 minutes (60% faster).
Triaged and remediated 40,000+ security vulnerabilities in six months across Linux packages and Java (Maven/Gradle) third-party dependencies, coordinating upgrade cycles for security and compliance.
Design, build, and support 60+ live, production-ready Dynamic Message Object (DMO) compilations in Java, defining cross-product messaging schemas and data contracts.
Develop and maintain backend services in Java and Spring Boot, ensuring cross-environment compatibility and managing release branch promotion for QA validation.
Provide production support and infrastructure troubleshooting to 7 engineering teams, performing root cause analysis on messaging, deployment, and dependency issues.
Author JUnit and Jest unit and integration tests and automate delivery through Jenkins CI/CD pipelines, maintaining code quality across releases.

work.title: Front End Engineer (Apprenticeship)
highlights: Improved application efficiency 20% and expanded functionality 50% within 9 months by revamping 30+ reusable UI components using JavaScript (ES6), TypeScript, and React.js.

work.title: Front End / UI Developer (Apprenticeship)
highlights: Built and unit-tested reusable UI components for internal banking tools using JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and Jest.

projects.name: Yahoo Finance
highlights: Built a real-time single-page application on the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js) with WebSocket streaming and third-party market-data APIs (Finnhub, Financial Modeling Prep); automated regression testing with Selenium.

projects.name: AWS Console
highlights: Implemented AWS Cognito authentication and an AWS Cloudscape design-system UI backed by GraphQL and AWS Amplify; added a caching layer that reduced API response times 50% and server costs 15%.
Refactored legacy code with cross-functional teams, reducing system errors 40% and delivering 5 features ahead of schedule.
